mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as a tight labor market typically indicates strong economic growth and corporate earnings expansion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A Fed funds rate below 2.5% (FEDFUNDS < 2.5) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as a low policy rate signals accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0) and the Fed funds rate is below 2.5% (FEDFUNDS < 2.5), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive 20-day forward returns, as the combination of a tight labor market and accommodative monetary policy signals strong economic growth without excessive rate hikes.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 4.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.5) occurs in more than 30% of the time, but the 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 4.0), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative 20-day forward returns due to overvaluation and the risk of Fed tightening, as the economy approaches its potential growth rate and policy tightening becomes imminent.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO > 108.0) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong manufacturing activity indicates robust economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 108.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 1200.0) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as rising housing starts indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 250.0 (CPIAUCSL > 250.0) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as elevated inflation signals potential Fed tightening and increased market volatility.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or the Rank IC over a 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 149000.0) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as rising non-farm payrolls indicate sustained economic growth and corporate hiring, supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 149000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
